# Digital noise

Video static: mono or color noise that changes every frame, with occasional stronger horizontal bands. With motion off the static holds still.

<EffectDemo effect="digital-noise" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { digitalNoise } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/digital-noise';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(digitalNoise({ preset: 'light' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.amount = 0.15`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type              | Default  | Range      | Description                                    |
| --------- | ----------------- | -------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `amount`  | number            | `0.15`   | 0 – 1      | Strength of the static.                        |
| `mode`    | 'mono' \| 'color' | `'mono'` |            | Grey static, or independent noise per channel. |
| `size`    | number            | `1`      | 1 – 8 px   | Size of a noise cell.                          |
| `rate`    | number            | `30`     | 1 – 60 fps | How often the static changes.                  |
| `bands`   | number            | `0.2`    | 0 – 1      | How often stronger noise bands appear.         |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                  |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `light`  | `amount: 0.08`, `bands: 0.1`              |
| `tv`     | `amount: 0.35`, `size: 1.5`, `bands: 0.4` |
| `color`  | `mode: 'color'`, `amount: 0.2`            |
| `coarse` | `amount: 0.25`, `size: 4`, `rate: 12`     |

Apply one with `digitalNoise({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 6.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/digital-noise`, including the shared effect runtime.
